ja: • エルク・ドメル将軍座乗、大ガミラス帝国軍最大の艦「ドメラーズIII世」が1/1000スケールで登場。
• 主砲は旋回可能。スライド金型で砲口モールドを再現。
• 艦橋部「独立戦闘指揮艦」は分離可能。瞬間物質移送器装備タイプ／非装備タイプの選択が可能。
• 艦体の基本色はパーツの色分けで再現。両弦の発光部はクリアパーツで再現。
• 組立後は分割してコンパクトに収納が可能。
成形品×11、マーキングシール×1、ホイルシール×1、組立説明書×1
en: • The largest ship of the Great Garmillas Empire, "Domeraz III", seated by General Elk Domel, is now available in 1/1000 scale.
• The main gun can be rotated. Reproduce the muzzle mold with a slide mold.
• The bridge section "Independent Combat Command Ship" can be separated. You can choose between a type equipped with an instantaneous material transfer device and a type not equipped with it.
• The basic color of the ship is reproduced by color-coding the parts. The light emitting parts of both strings are reproduced with clear parts.
• After assembly, it can be separated for compact storage.
Molded product x 11, Marking Seal x 1, Foil Seal x 1, Assembly Manual x 1
